description: Ministry of Justice - Order to declare that the provisions of the Mutual Assistance in criminal Matters Act, No. 25 of 2002 shall apply in respect of the Agreement between the governments of Sri Lanka and the People's Republic of China
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of applicability of the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act to a specific international agreement between Sri Lanka and China. It involves legal/regulatory matters, specifically the implementation of an international treaty related to mutual legal assistance in criminal investigations and judicial proceedings, falling under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
